query: *[_type == "post" && kind == "ours" && $site in restaurants && defined(slug.current)] | order(date desc) { "slug": slug.current, title, date, summary, author, keywords, "featured": $site in featuredOn, "image": image{ alt, "asset": asset->{ _id, url, "w": metadata.dimensions.width, "h": metadata.dimensions.height } }, body }
